input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11 addresses term, breach termination and survival (including a run-off right for existing Customers and continuing support), but nowhere requires Commerce One to provide transition assistance or to return our and our Customers' data. The only post-termination data provision is the mutual Confidential Information return/destroy obligation in Section 11.3, which is not a data export right (no format, no timing, no machine-readable requirement) and gives Commerce One a destruction option over material it holds. Because Commerce One hosts the MarketSite.net Service accessed by Corio and its Customers (Section 2.6), data resides on Commerce One's systems, so an exit path is needed. Inserted Section 11.4 to match the playbook preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within thirty days, then deletion with written certification; fallback of 90 days' assistance offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 11.4 requiring Commerce One to provide transition assistance, return Corio and Customer data, and certify deletion after termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a transition-assistance and data-return provision: on expiry or termination Commerce One provides up to six months of assistance at its then-current rates, returns our and our Customers' data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then deletes and certifies deletion. Our playbook requires an orderly exit path, particularly where our Customers' data sits in the MarketSite.net Service; we can live with a 90-day assistance period if six months is unworkable.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return to Corio all data of Corio and its Customers in Commerce One's possession or control, including data stored or processed in connection with the Software or the MarketSite.net Service, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing. This Section 11.4 shall survive any termination or expiration of this Agreement.
